thesis: The page is the visit clipboard: every section is a room on the checklist, and the signature is the pencil tick that draws itself as you scroll through the timed visit.

signature.name: Visit Timeline Tick
signature.summary: Vertical timeline rail with mono timestamps; pencil-stroke tick SVG draws beside checklist items as sections enter view via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, reviews, and footer.

motion.intro: Clipboard rises; three ticks draw sequentially (1.1s, skippable).
stories: Pinned timeline rail with advancing clock and room ticks (draw)
Estimator timeline bar fills to duration (dial)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX
